      Trust

      Built to be trusted with your practice’s money.

      Licensed partners hold the money
      Aria is a technology company, not a bank. Cards will be issued and accounts held by licensed partner institutions, which we will name before launch.
      Careful with sensitive data
      We won’t take in any patient information from your practice until we’ve signed a business associate agreement with you. We are building Aria with encryption and strict access controls, and will publish our security practices before launch.
      AI that asks first
      Nothing is paid, moved or changed without a person signing off.
      Terms in writing first
      You will see pricing and terms in writing before you apply for anything.

      Questions

      What practices ask us.

      Something we haven’t covered? Talk to us.

      What will Aria cost?

      Pricing isn’t final. Practices on the waitlist will see pricing and terms in writing before applying for anything, and joining the waitlist is free with no obligation.

      Do we have to switch banks?

      No. The card works alongside your current bank, and you fund it from your existing account.

      Is Aria a bank?

      No. Aria is a financial technology company. Card services will be provided by licensed partner institutions, which we’ll name before launch.

      Corporate cards

      A card for each person who buys for the practice.

      The Aria card is built to replace the mix of personal cards, reimbursements and the owner’s card being passed around the front desk. Each person who orders will get a physical or virtual card with limits you set.

      Join the waitlistTalk to us
      Sample

      Cards will be provided by licensed partners and are subject to approval.

      What it does

      Physical and virtual cards
      Issue cards to owners, managers and staff in minutes, and virtual cards for online vendors and subscriptions.
      Limits that fit the job
      Set limits by person, category and vendor, so each card can only be used for what it’s for.
      Freeze or adjust any time
      Change a limit, pause a card or close it from your phone, and the change applies right away.
      Fast card replacements
      If a card is lost or compromised, issue a virtual replacement on the spot, so ordering doesn’t stop while a new card is in the mail.
      Education and renewals
      Give each provider a budget for courses and conferences, and for license and DEA renewals, on their own card.
      Bookkeeping
      Each purchase will be categorized for your books.

      Product images are illustrations with sample figures.

      CFO hubExpense management

      Expense management

      Built to replace expense reports and shoeboxes of receipts.

      Each card purchase will ask for its receipt by text or email, match it and apply a category your bookkeeper will recognize, like medical supplies, lab fees or continuing education. Out-of-pocket purchases, like mileage for home visits, will be reimbursed from the same place.

      What it does

      AI receipt matching
      Snap a photo or forward an email. Aria AI is built to read the receipt, match it to the right purchase and write the memo for you.

      Fast reimbursements
      Staff submit out-of-pocket costs and mileage from their phone, you approve, and they’re repaid by direct deposit within days, not on the next check run.
      AI policy checks
      Aria AI is built to check each purchase against your policy and flag anything that needs a second look.

      Corporate cardsBill pay

      Bill pay

      Each vendor bill in one queue.

      Forward supplier, lab, distributor and landlord invoices to Aria. Each one will be read for you, routed to the right person for approval and paid on the date you choose: by card where the vendor accepts it, by bank transfer, or by a paper check we print and mail for you.

      Join the waitlistTalk to us

      $640.00
      Office rentPaid Oct 1

      What it does

      AI invoice reading
      Forward invoices by email or upload them. Aria AI is built to pull out the vendor, amount, due date and line items, and code the bill to the right account.
      Duplicate and price checks
      Aria AI will flag a bill that looks like one you have already paid, or a price that is higher than last time, before anything goes out.
      Approvals
      Choose who approves which bills, so nothing is paid without the right sign-off.
      Every location and tax ID
      Run bills for several locations or entities from one login, each with its own books and approvers.
      Scheduled payments
      Pay on the due date, not before, and keep cash in your account longer.
      Vendor contracts
      Keep agreed prices and renewal dates with each vendor, and get a flag when an invoice is higher than agreed.
      Card where accepted
      Pay vendors by card when they take it, so more of your bills are tracked in one place.

      Product images are illustrations with sample figures.

      Claims and remittance

      See what each insurer paid, and whether it reached your bank.

      Insurer payments arrive in lump sums and are matched by hand. Claims and remittance is built to show what each insurer sent and match it to your deposits.

      Join the waitlistSee how it works

      What it does

      AI payment matching
      Aria AI is built to read remittance files and match each insurer payment to its bank deposit, including lump-sum ones.
      Short-payments explained
      When a deposit comes in short of its remittance, Aria AI will flag it and explain the insurer’s reason codes in plain English.

      Aria is in development and opening to practices in stages. Features and timing may change. Product images are illustrations with sample figures.

      The gap

      When what the insurer reported paying doesn’t match what reached your bank.

      Payer ASample data
      Remittance says835 from Payer A
      $10,459.82
      Bank receivedDeposit Sep 22
      $10,159.82
      GapShort · $300.00

      How it works

      How Aria AI checks each payment.

      1. The deposit lands

        Reads your remittances and bank deposits

      2. Matched to its remittance

        Will match each insurer payment to its deposit

      3. Short or missing, flagged

        Will flag gaps and track each insurer’s days to pay

      Claims checking doesn’t post payments, file or appeal claims, contact insurers or move money.

      Books that are already done when the month ends.

      Each card purchase, bill and deposit will sync to your accounting software with its receipt, category and location already applied, so your bookkeeper reviews instead of retyping.         Primary & behavioral care

        A card for the practices patients see first.

        Primary care, pediatric, OB-GYN, urgent care and behavioral health practices buy steadily and often: vaccines and point-of-care tests, exam and procedure supplies, reference labs, and the software that keeps the schedule full. Choose your specialty to see what Aria covers.

        For primary care practices

        A card for the practice that sees everyone.

        Primary care runs on a steady stream of small orders and a few very large ones: seasonal flu and adult vaccine stock, point-of-care testing kits, reference lab invoices and the exam and procedure supplies for everything from well visits to I&Ds. Aria is built to put all of it on one card, each purchase coded to the right category, and each invoice paid from the same place.

        Join the waitlistTalk to us

        Where the money goes

        Most primary care practices spend the bulk of their budget on vaccines and immunization supplies, reference lab and pathology fees, point-of-care tests, like strep, flu, COVID and A1c, exam, venipuncture and minor procedure supplies, and EHR, e-prescribing and scheduling software. Those are the purchases Aria is designed around.

        How the card helps

        Vaccine orders on one card
        Seasonal flu and adult vaccine pre-books go on the card instead of a check, with the receipt matched and the lot invoice kept with it.
        Cards for the people who restock
        Your MAs and office manager order exam paper, needles and POC test kits on their own cards, capped at the amounts you set.
        Lab and vendor invoices in one queue
        Reference lab and vendor bills will be read by Aria AI, approved in a tap and paid on the due date.

        Also on Aria

        AI matching of insurer payments to your bank deposits.

        For pediatrics practices

        A card for practices that run on the vaccine schedule.

        For most pediatric offices, vaccines are the largest, most time-sensitive purchase on the books, from DTaP and MMR to RSV immunizations every fall, alongside the supplies for well-child checks, hearing and vision screening and point-of-care testing. Aria will let you buy them, and everything else, on one card, with clear limits for the people who place the orders.

        For OB-GYN practices

        A card for OB-GYN practices.

Aria is built to put it on one card, with each payment scheduled on the date you choose.
